title: E2E tests reference packages not declared in Directory.Packages.props (central package management violation)
evidence_snippet:
<!-- E2ETests.csproj lines 15-17 -->
<PackageReference Include="NUnit" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit.Analyzers" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit3TestAdapter" />
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit" />

<!-- Directory.Packages.props has no matching <PackageVersion> for any of these -->
rule_violated: Central Package Management: all PackageReference items must have a corresponding PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props when ManagePackageVersionsCentrally is true
remediation: Add <PackageVersion> entries for NUnit, NUnit.Analyzers, NUnit3TestAdapter, and Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit to Directory.Packages.props. Example: <PackageVersion Include="NUnit" Version="4.3.2" />. This is build-breaking.

title: E2ETests project missing explicit RootNamespace and AssemblyName properties
rule_violated: Project Convention Consistency (all projects should use explicit RootNamespace/AssemblyName)
remediation: Add <RootNamespace>ContestJudging.E2ETests</RootNamespace> and <AssemblyName>ContestJudging.E2ETests</AssemblyName> to the E2ETests.csproj PropertyGroup.

title: Redundant TargetFramework/Nullable/ImplicitUsings overrides in Web.csproj
evidence_snippet:
// Web.csproj duplicates Directory.Build.props values:
<TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
<Nullable>enable</Nullable>
<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
rule_violated: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) / Build configuration conventions
remediation: Remove the TargetFramework, Nullable, and ImplicitUsings properties from Web.csproj's PropertyGroup; rely on Directory.Build.props inheritance. Same applies to E2ETests.csproj.

title: Orphaned testapp scaffold project outside solution
rule_violated: Solution Hygiene (no orphaned/unreferenced projects)
remediation: Delete the entire testapp/ directory if it's a scaffolding artifact. If it serves a purpose, add it to the solution and conform it to project conventions (central package management, namespace naming).

title: Trim analyzer enabled globally but EF Core (Infrastructure) is not trimming-safe
rule_violated: Build Configuration (trim settings should be scoped to the published project, not class libraries)
remediation: Move <IsTrimmable> and <EnableTrimAnalyzer> from Directory.Build.props into the Web.csproj PropertyGroup. Class libraries (Core, Infrastructure, Services) should not be marked trimmable since the consuming app controls trimming. Or scope with a Condition="'$(IsPublishable)' == 'true'".

title: Dead empty class Class1.cs in Infrastructure project
rule_violated: Stub/placeholder with no implementation in production source
remediation: Delete the file. It has no purpose and adds dead weight to the assembly.
validation_note: Severity downgraded from high to low per V1-B validation (empty dead class is not high-impact)

title: Widespread var usage violations against .editorconfig mandate
evidence_snippet:
// ~50+ locations found using explicit types where editorconfig mandates var
string root = uf.Find(entryId);  // should be: var root
int n = allEntryIdsList.Count;   // should be: var n
double sum = nextGamma.Sum();    // should be: var sum
rule_violated: editorconfig:csharp_style_var_for_built_in_types=true:suggestion, csharp_style_var_when_type_is_apparent=true:suggestion, csharp_style_var_elsewhere=true:suggestion (lines 24-26)
remediation: Run `dotnet format` on the solution to auto-fix all var preferences at once.

title: No sealed classes anywhere in the codebase
rule_violated: CA1852 — Type can be sealed when it has no visible subclasses. JIT cannot devirtualize calls without sealed.
remediation: Add `sealed` to all leaf classes. For DI-registered implementations, sealed enables devirtualization. For entity classes, sealing removes virtual method table overhead.

title: Large methods exceeding 50-line maintainability threshold
evidence_snippet:
ResolveGlobalStrengths: 116 lines, 3-deep nested loops
IsTotalOrder: 85 lines
IsValidOrder: 84 lines
GetSortedTiers: 97 lines
rule_violated: Method length >50 lines degrades readability, testability, and indicates single-responsibility violation
remediation: Extract inner loops into named private methods (e.g., IterateBradleyTerryStep, BuildTopologicalTiers). This also reduces nesting depth.

title: Magic numbers without named constants
evidence_snippet:
if (range < 1e-9)                                     // 2 scoring files
if (iter > 50 && iter % 10 == 0)                       // BradleyTerry:90
if (stable && maxDiff < 1e-3)                          // BradleyTerry:108
rule_violated: Magic numbers obscure intent; use named constants
remediation: Define constants: const double Epsilon = 1e-9; const int RankStabilityCheckStart = 50; const int RankStabilityCheckInterval = 10; const double RankStabilityThreshold = 1e-3;

title: Tuple<string, string> should be ValueTuple (string, string)
rule_violated: Use modern C# ValueTuple structs over reference-type Tuple for performance
remediation: Change to private (string A, string B)? suggestedPair; and assign with suggestedPair = (a, b);

title: Missing sealed on private nested UnionFind class
rule_violated: CA1852 — even private nested types benefit from sealed for JIT devirtualization
remediation: Change to `private sealed class UnionFind`.

title: No parameterized tests (Theories) used — all tests use Fact with sequential Assert.Throws
rule_violated: xUnit best practices: parameterized tests ([Theory]) over repeated Assert.Throws in a single [Fact]
remediation: Convert boundary tests to [Theory] with [InlineData]. If the first assertion throws/fails, the second never executes, masking defects. Same for Entry_SetScore_InvalidScore_Throws (tests 11 and -1 in one Fact).

title: ContestJudging.Web project has zero unit tests
rule_violated: Testing pyramid: missing unit tests for UI/presentation layer logic
remediation: Add bunit or similar Blazor testing library. Test pure-logic methods: FindSuggestedPair(), GetFilteredEntries(), GeneratePartitions(), CalculateResults(), keyboard handler, DI validation. Add ContestJudging.Web.Tests project.

title: No test categories/traits to distinguish unit tests from integration tests
rule_violated: xUnit best practices: test categorization for CI pipeline efficiency
remediation: Add [Trait("Category", "Unit")] to unit test classes and [Trait("Category", "Integration")] to InfrastructureTests. Configure CI with dotnet test --filter "Category!=Integration" for PRs.

title: ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices has no test coverage
rule_violated: Testing: critical infrastructure/pathway code should have coverage
remediation: Add a test that calls AddContestJudgingServices, builds IServiceProvider, resolves each registered service, and asserts non-null and correct concrete type. Use in-memory SQLite.

title: Vague test class name 'CoreTests' — unclear what it tests
rule_violated: Consistency: test class names should map to the class under test (e.g., CategoryTests, EntryTests)
remediation: Split into CategoryTests.cs and EntryTests.cs, or rename to CoreEntityTests.

title: E2E tests use NUnit while unit tests use xUnit — framework inconsistency
rule_violated: Consistency: single test framework reduces cognitive load across the project
remediation: Migrate E2E to xUnit (using Microsoft.Playwright without NUnit adapter) or document the rationale for the split.

title: ContestManager ExportDataAsync/ImportDataAsync untested
rule_violated: Testing: critical data path (backup/restore) has no coverage
remediation: Add integration tests using in-memory context that verify round-trip: export, wipe, import, verify data matches.

title: TrimmingSafetyTests suppresses trimming warnings it's meant to validate
rule_violated: Testing: trimming safety tests should validate behavior under trimming without suppressing trimming warnings
remediation: Use source-generated JSON serializer (JsonSerializerContext) or remove [RequiresUnreferencedCode] and run this test explicitly in a trimmed publish build to detect actual breaks.

title: No cancellation token support in async tests or underlying async methods
rule_violated: Testing: async tests should validate cancellation behavior where applicable
remediation: If the underlying async operations support cancellation, add tests with CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan). If not, consider adding CancellationToken support to repository interfaces.

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header in index.html
evidence_snippet:
<!-- index.html:4-15 -- no CSP meta tag present -->
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>EOH 2026 Contest Judging</title>
    <base href="/" />
    ...
</head>
rule_violated: OWASP A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration, CWE-1021
remediation: Add a Content-Security-Policy meta tag with directives appropriate for Blazor WASM: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:;

title: Insecure random number generation using System.Random in PartitionService
rule_violated: CWE-338 Use of Cryptographically Weak PRNG
remediation: Replace System.Random with System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator for partition shuffling, or use Random.Shared with explicit documentation that the randomness is non-cryptographic.

title: Database backup in localStorage lacks integrity verification
rule_violated: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
remediation: Append an HMAC-SHA256 or CRC32 checksum to the backup payload before storing in localStorage. Verify on restore and reject if integrity check fails.

title: Missing .db and .sqlite patterns in .gitignore
evidence_snippet:
// .gitignore has *.dbmdl (line 244) but no *.db or *.sqlite pattern.
// The application creates contest.db as its SQLite database file.
rule_violated: Database files containing contest data should not be committed to version control
remediation: Add *.db, *.sqlite, and *.sqlite3 patterns to .gitignore.

title: No authentication on administrative operations
rule_violated: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
remediation: Add a passphrase gate on the Setup page or implement token-based auth if server-side deployment is planned. Document the trusted-device deployment model if auth is intentionally omitted.

title: Client-side SQLite — entire database accessible to browser user
rule_violated: Blazor WASM runs entirely client-side; all data is accessible via browser DevTools
remediation: Document the trust model in a SECURITY.md or README: this app is designed for a trusted judge's local device. If data confidentiality is needed, implement a backend API with server-side persistence.

title: E2E test project excluded from solution — Playwright/NUnit tests never run in CI
evidence_snippet:
<Folder Name="/tests/">
    <Project Path="tests/ContestJudging.Tests/ContestJudging.Tests.csproj" />
</Folder>
rule_violated: CI completeness — all test projects must be exercised in the pipeline
remediation: Add <Project Path="tests/ContestJudging.E2ETests/ContestJudging.E2ETests.csproj" /> to the /tests/ folder in ContestJudging.slnx. Consider a separate CI job for E2E tests with Playwright browser installation.

title: No code coverage collected in CI despite coverlet.collector being configured
evidence_snippet: dotnet test ContestJudging.slnx --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal
rule_violated: Test quality — coverage should be measured and tracked
remediation: Add --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" to the dotnet test command and optionally upload results to a coverage service.

title: Six of seven GitHub Actions use floating major-version tags (supply chain risk)
evidence_snippet:
uses: actions/checkout@v6
uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
uses: actions/cache@v5
rule_violated: SLSA Level 2 — actions should be pinned to digest or full semver
remediation: Pin all actions to full semver (e.g., actions/checkout@v6.1.0) or commit SHA. Enable Dependabot for GitHub Actions updates.

title: No SAST or CodeQL scanning — only dependency scanning is present
evidence_snippet:
security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: OSV-Scanner
        uses: google/osv-scanner-action/osv-scanner-action@v2.3.5
rule_violated: OWASP / DevSecOps — SAST should complement dependency vulnerability scanning
remediation: Add a CodeQL analysis job targeting csharp (and optionally javascript for Blazor WASM client). github/codeql-action provides free scanning for public repos.

title: OSV-Scanner uses --allow-no-lockfiles reducing scan accuracy
evidence_snippet: scan-args: ./ --allow-no-lockfiles
rule_violated: Tool configuration — lock files provide precise dependency graphs
remediation: Remove --allow-no-lockfiles. If scans fail without lock files, commit packages.lock.json or enable lock file generation in Directory.Packages.props.

title: release/ directory (published Blazor WASM output) is committed to the repository
evidence_snippet:
release/
  ContestJudging.Web.runtimeconfig.json
  dotnet.js
  e_sqlite3.a
  web.config
  wwwroot/
    _framework/
    index.html
    ...
rule_violated: Repository hygiene — build artifacts should not be version-controlled
remediation: Add release/ to .gitignore and run git rm -r --cached release/. The CI deploy job already publishes to this path.

title: No Dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates
evidence_snippet: (missing) .github/dependabot.yml
rule_violated: Dependency hygiene — automated updates prevent staleness and known vulnerabilities
remediation: Create .github/dependabot.yml with nuget and github-actions ecosystems on a weekly schedule.

title: No CODEOWNERS file for automated PR review assignment
evidence_snippet: (missing) .github/CODEOWNERS
rule_violated: Code review hygiene — CODEOWNERS ensures appropriate reviewers
remediation: Create .github/CODEOWNERS with default ownership (e.g., * @pngdeity/maintainers).

title: No PR template or issue templates
evidence_snippet: (missing) .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
rule_violated: Contribution hygiene — templates standardize submissions
remediation: Add .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with a checklist (tests, format, docs) and a bug report issue template.

title: dotnet-tools.json manifest has no tools configured
evidence_snippet: "tools": {}
rule_violated: Reproducibility — local tool pinning ensures consistent CLI tool versions across environments
remediation: No action required currently. If additional CLI tools are introduced (dotnet-coverage, dotnet-outdated, etc.), register them via dotnet tool install --local.

title: Deploy job redundantly rebuilds from source instead of reusing tested artifacts
evidence_snippet:
deploy:
    needs: [quality-and-test, security-scan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup .NET ...
      - name: Publish Blazor WASM
        run: dotnet publish src/ContestJudging.Web/ContestJudging.Web.csproj ...
rule_violated: CI integrity — deploy should use tested artifacts, not rebuild
remediation: In the quality-and-test job, run dotnet publish and upload the result via actions/upload-artifact. In the deploy job, download that artifact via actions/download-artifact instead of rebuilding.

title: Web project directly references Infrastructure layer — SQLitePCL init and ContestDbContext resolved in UI startup
rule_violated: Clean Architecture: Dependency Rule — outer layers (Web) must not depend on inner layers (Infrastructure) for anything except DI composition
remediation: 1) Remove Infrastructure ProjectReference and EF Core/SQLite PackageReferences from Web.csproj. 2) Move SQLitePCL.Batteries_V2.Init() into ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices(). 3) Replace direct ContestDbContext resolution in Program.cs with an IDatabaseInitializer abstraction or move database restore into Services. 4) Web should only call builder.Services.AddContestJudgingServices() as its single composition entry point.

title: ContestManager (Services/Application layer) directly depends on concrete ContestDbContext from Infrastructure
rule_violated: SOLID: Dependency Inversion Principle — high-level modules (Services/ContestManager) must not depend on low-level modules (Infrastructure/ContestDbContext); both should depend on abstractions. Clean Architecture: inner layers must not know about outer layer concretions.
remediation: 1) Extract an IDatabaseBackupService interface (export/import byte array) into Core.Interfaces. 2) Implement DatabaseBackupService in Infrastructure with raw file I/O. 3) Have ContestManager depend on IDatabaseBackupService instead of ContestDbContext. 4) Remove ExportDatabaseAsync/ImportDatabaseAsync from ContestDbContext (fixing ARCH-004). 5) Update tests to use the mockable IDatabaseBackupService abstraction.

title: Service interfaces (IValidationService, IPartitionService, IGlobalRankingService, IContestManager) defined in Services project instead of Core
rule_violated: SOLID: Dependency Inversion Principle — abstractions should be owned by the policy-defining layer (Core or Application.Abstractions), not the implementation layer. Clean Architecture: Dependency Rule — all compile-time dependencies point inward.
remediation: 1) Move IValidationService, IPartitionService, IGlobalRankingService, and IContestManager to ContestJudging.Core.Interfaces. 2) Update using directives in all implementations and Web consumers. 3) Consider a separate ContestJudging.Core.Interfaces.Services sub-namespace or a ContestJudging.Application.Abstractions project for service-level abstractions distinct from domain abstractions.

title: ContestDbContext violates Single Responsibility — mixes ORM configuration with raw file I/O export/import
rule_violated: SOLID: Single Responsibility Principle — a class should have only one reason to change. ContestDbContext should change only when the data model changes, not when the backup persistence mechanism changes. Clean Code: separation of concerns — data access and file I/O backup are distinct responsibilities that should not be co-located.
remediation: 1) Move ExportDatabaseAsync and ImportDatabaseAsync into a dedicated DatabaseBackupService class in Infrastructure. 2) Inject database path via configuration instead of hardcoding 'contest.db'. 3) Register IDatabaseBackupService in DI. 4) Remove these methods from ContestDbContext entirely. This also enables fixing ARCH-002 by giving ContestManager a mockable abstraction for backup operations.

title: Composition root (ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices) in Services layer instead of outermost layer
rule_violated: Clean Architecture Composition Root pattern — the composition root should be as close to the application entry point (the outermost layer, Web) as possible. Only the entry-point assembly should reference all other assemblies. Inner layers should not need knowledge of concrete implementations from outer layers.
remediation: 1) Move ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices to the Web project (or a Web DI folder). 2) Remove the Services → Infrastructure project reference. 3) Services should only reference Core and define interfaces there (see ARCH-003). 4) Register all implementations from the Web composition root, where references to all projects are natural.

title: Two IScoringStrategy implementations exist but are never registered in DI container
rule_violated: Principle of Least Surprise — multiple strategy implementations exist but only one is wired in DI. If the alternatives are dead code they should be removed; if they're live, they should be selectable via configuration. YAGNI — code that ships but can never be reached from the application entry point is dead weight.
remediation: 1) If PercentileScoring and DefinedIntervalScoring are production features: add a configuration mechanism (enum, settings key) to select the active scoring strategy at startup. 2) For DefinedIntervalScoring, implement a factory registration that reads rank points from configuration. 3) If they are legacy/experimental: delete the unused implementation files and their tests.

title: AddScoped DbContext lifetime in Blazor WASM — DbContext effectively singleton, change tracker grows unbounded
rule_violated: EF Core best practices — DbContext instances should be short-lived per unit-of-work. In Blazor WASM, AddDbContextFactory<T> should be used to create short-lived contexts per operation, or ChangeTracker.Clear() should be called periodically to prevent unbounded memory growth.
remediation: 1) Replace AddDbContext<ContestDbContext> with AddDbContextFactory<ContestDbContext>. 2) Update repositories to inject IDbContextFactory<ContestDbContext> and create/dispose DbContext per operation. 3) Alternatively, call context.ChangeTracker.Clear() after batch operations (e.g., after CalculateGlobalScoresAsync in ContestManager). 4) The startup database restore in Program.cs should create a temporary context and dispose it immediately.

title: GetSortedTiers silently ignores contradictory self-loop edges unlike IsTotalOrder/IsValidOrder
rule_violated: Defense in depth — contradictory equivalence-class self-loop must be rejected uniformly across all analysis methods
remediation: Change line 264 to `if (u == v) throw new InvalidOperationException(...)` or add a boolean output parameter to signal validity. At minimum, match the `return false` behavior of the other two methods.

title: Three methods contain 100% duplicated Kahn's Algorithm logic with only minor behavioral differences
rule_violated: DRY — algorithm must be defined once and composed; duplicate implementations create divergent-fix risk
remediation: Extract a private method (e.g., TryBuildTopologicalOrder) returning the order list or null on cycle. IsValidOrder wraps it checking for non-null. IsTotalOrder additionally verifies uniqueness via the single-source BFS property. GetSortedTiers groups the resulting order into tiers.

title: UnionFind implementation lacks union-by-rank/size for optimal complexity
rule_violated: Union-Find textbook optimality requires both path compression and union-by-rank to achieve O(alpha(n)) amortized; missing union-by-rank limits to O(log n)
remediation: Add a private Dictionary<string, int> _rank field. In Union, attach the smaller-rank tree under the larger-rank root, incrementing rank when equal.

title: Theoretical division-by-zero in BradleyTerry denominator for crafted zero-gamma entries
rule_violated: Robustness — numeric algorithms must guard against division-by-zero even in edge cases only reachable through crafted input
remediation: Add a guard: if (gamma[i] + gamma[j] < 1e-12) continue; inside the inner loop at line 69.

title: Partition bridge node count can evaluate to zero at small overlap rates, breaking connectivity guarantee
rule_violated: Invariant from README — partitioning must ensure statistical connectivity; zero bridge nodes violates this guarantee
remediation: Enforce a minimum: int bCount = Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Round(n * overlapRate)) when kPartitions > 1 and n > 0. Alternatively validate overlapRate * n >= kPartitions - 1 before proceeding.

title: OnInitializedAsync methods lack exception handling in all three page components
rule_violated: Blazor best practice: lifecycle methods that perform I/O should catch exceptions and display user-friendly errors
remediation: Wrap OnInitializedAsync bodies in try-catch; set an errorMessage field to display in the UI rather than crashing to the global error boundary.

title: BackupDatabase invoked on every Setup page load and every mutation, causing excessive localStorage writes
rule_violated: Performance: full-database export + base64 encode + localStorage write on every CRUD operation is excessive I/O in a browser runtime
remediation: Decouple backup from RefreshData. Save on a debounced timer, on page navigation away (Dispose), or use a dirty flag to track whether data has changed since last save.

title: No localStorage quota check before storing multi-MB SQLite backup
evidence_snippet:
await LocalStorage.SetItemAsStringAsync("db_backup", Convert.ToBase64String(data));
// No QuotaExceededError handling, no size threshold check before storing
rule_violated: Defensive programming: browser localStorage has 5-10MB origin quota; exceeding it throws QuotaExceededError which is uncaught here
remediation: Check data.Length against a safe threshold (e.g., 4MB) before writing. Wrap SetItemAsStringAsync in try-catch for QuotaExceededError. Show a user warning when the backup cannot be saved.

title: Bootstrap JavaScript not loaded in index.html — accordion UI in Judging page is non-functional
evidence_snippet:
<!-- index.html:9-11 -- only Bootstrap CSS, no JS -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" />

<!-- Judging.razor:97 -- depends on Bootstrap JS which is never loaded -->
<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button"
        data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#manualEntry">
    Manual Override / Correction
</button>
rule_violated: Functional correctness: Bootstrap JS-dependent components (accordion) are broken because the JS bundle is not referenced
remediation: Add <script src="lib/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script> to index.html before </body>. Or replace the Bootstrap accordion with Blazor-native conditional rendering (@if (showManualEntry) { ... }) to eliminate the JS dependency.

title: Interactive div elements missing ARIA roles, keyboard handlers, and tabindex
evidence_snippet:
<!-- Clickable divs acting as buttons without button semantics -->
<div class="judge-card h-100 text-center p-5 ..."
     @onclick="() => RecordResult(Operator.GreaterThan)">
    <!-- No role="button", no tabindex, no @onkeydown -->

<!-- Toggle button without aria-label -->
<button title="Navigation menu" class="navbar-toggler" @onclick="ToggleNavMenu">
rule_violated: WCAG 2.1: 4.1.2 Name/Role/Value — interactive elements must expose their role and state to assistive technology; 2.1.1 Keyboard — all functionality must be operable through keyboard
remediation: Replace judge-card divs with <button> elements for built-in ARIA semantics, or add role="button", tabindex="0", @onkeydown handlers for Enter/Space, and aria-label to each div. Add aria-keyshortcuts="A S D" to the judging container. Add aria-label to the navbar toggle button.

title: Large lists rendered without Virtualize component
rule_violated: Performance: rendering 200+ items without Virtualize causes unnecessary DOM nodes, memory usage, and slow initial render
remediation: Replace @foreach with <Virtualize Items="@categories" Context="cat"> for lists that can exceed ~50 items. Relations list and leaderboard are the best candidates.

title: Orphaned weather.json scaffold file in production wwwroot output
evidence_snippet:
[
  { "date": "2022-01-06", "temperatureC": 1, "summary": "Freezing" },
  ...
]
rule_violated: Clean code: scaffold/template artifacts should be removed before production use
remediation: Delete wwwroot/sample-data/weather.json and the containing sample-data/ directory.

title: No database migration files; schema managed exclusively via EnsureCreatedAsync()
rule_violated: EF Core best practice: EnsureCreated() is for testing/in-memory scenarios only. Production apps must use migrations for versioned, upgradeable schema management.
remediation: Run 'dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate' to generate a migration. Replace EnsureCreatedAsync() with Database.MigrateAsync() in Program.cs. This preserves data across schema changes and tracks model snapshots.

title: Missing foreign key relationships in entity configuration
rule_violated: EF Core schema integrity: without explicit FK configuration, referential integrity is not enforced at the database level. SQLite has FK enforcement off by default.
remediation: Add Fluent API relationships (HasOne/WithMany/HasForeignKey/OnDelete) for EntryEntity->EntryScoreEntity, EntryScoreEntity->CategoryEntity, and RelationEntity->CategoryEntity. Enable foreign keys at connection open. Remove manual cascade deletion code in repository DeleteAsync methods after FKs are configured.

title: Database restore overwrites file with active DbContext connection; swallowed exception masks data loss
rule_violated: Best practice: never overwrite an open database file via raw filesystem I/O. Never swallow exceptions silently when data operations are at stake.
remediation: Restructure startup: check LocalStorage for backup before creating the DbContext scope. Dispose of existing connection, restore file, then create fresh DbContext. Log ex.ToString() instead of ex.Message. Set an error flag for UI notification.

title: O(n*m) client-side join in SqliteEntryRepository queries
rule_violated: EF Core query efficiency: prefer database-side JOINs over client-side correlation loops. O(n*m) vs O(n) with SQL JOIN.
remediation: Add a Category navigation property to EntryScoreEntity. Configure FK in OnModelCreating. Use .Include(e => e.Scores).ThenInclude(s => s.Category) and access scoreEntity.Category directly. This emits a single SQL JOIN.

title: Missing .AsNoTracking() on all read-only repository queries
rule_violated: EF Core performance best practice: use .AsNoTracking() for read-only queries to avoid change tracker overhead.
remediation: Add .AsNoTracking() to GetAllAsync, GetByIdAsync, and GetByCategoryIdAsync queries. For UpdateAsync methods that mutate entities, keep tracking enabled.

title: CalculateGlobalScoresAsync performs individual entry updates without transaction wrapping
rule_violated: ACID best practice: multi-entity mutations representing a single logical operation must be wrapped in a transaction.
remediation: Wrap the scoring loop in a transaction via _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(). Alternatively, refactor UpdateAsync to not call SaveChangesAsync internally and batch all changes in a single SaveChangesAsync call at the end of the loop.

title: Connection string hardcoded in Program.cs rather than sourced from configuration
rule_violated: Twelve-Factor App / .NET conventions: configuration should come from appsettings.json, environment variables, or configuration providers.
remediation: Read connection string from builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("ContestDb") or appsettings. Store the DB path there. This also makes swapping to :memory: for tests trivial.

title: Missing indexes on frequently queried foreign key columns
rule_violated: Database performance: index columns used in WHERE and JOIN clauses.
remediation: Add .HasIndex(r => r.CategoryId) on RelationEntity and .HasIndex(es => es.EntryId) on EntryScoreEntity in OnModelCreating.

title: No error handling around SaveChangesAsync calls in repository methods
rule_violated: Defensive programming: persistence operations should catch and wrap data-access exceptions with domain-meaningful error types.
remediation: Wrap SaveChangesAsync() in try/catch. Catch DbUpdateException and inspect its inner exception to provide user-actionable messages. Re-throw as a custom domain exception or log with context.

title: EntryScoreEntity has redundant surrogate key alongside natural composite unique constraint
rule_violated: Schema normalization: avoid redundant surrogate keys when the natural key is sufficient and no referencing FKs require it.
remediation: Remove the Id property and make (EntryId, CategoryId) the composite primary key via modelBuilder.Entity<EntryScoreEntity>().HasKey(es => new { es.EntryId, es.CategoryId }).

title: No .IsRequired() or .HasMaxLength() configuration on string entity properties
rule_violated: EF Core schema precision: explicit column constraints improve model clarity and enable database-level validation.
remediation: Add .IsRequired() and .HasMaxLength(256) to all string PK/FK properties in OnModelCreating.

title: PartitionService tests are non-deterministic due to unseeded Random
rule_violated: Testing: tests must be deterministic and reproducible; unseeded Random produces different results per run
remediation: Inject Random or an IRandomProvider into PartitionService. Tests should use new Random(42) for deterministic shuffling.

title: ContestManager ExportDataAsync/ImportDataAsync are structurally untestable due to concrete ContestDbContext dependency
rule_violated: SOLID:DIP — depending on concrete implementation prevents unit testing of I/O-bound methods
remediation: Extract IDatabaseExportImport interface with ExportAsync/ImportAsync, implement in ContestDbContext, inject into ContestManager.

title: LocalStorage backup/restore pipeline has zero test coverage across all layers
rule_violated: Testing: critical data persistence path (only persistence in Blazor WASM) has no coverage
remediation: Extract backup/restore to dedicated IBackupService. Add integration test for round-trip: write data, backup, wipe, restore, verify.

title: BradleyTerryResolutionService convergence and early-exit paths completely untested
rule_violated: Testing: algorithmic correctness — convergence path with the most complex logic (MLE + rank stability) is unexercised
remediation: Add test with 10+ entries and partial rankings requiring 50+ iterations. Add tests for empty input, single entry, and MaxIterations exhaustion.

title: CalculateScoresFromStrengths untested across all three scoring strategies
rule_violated: Testing: IScoringStrategy interface has two methods; only CalculateScores is tested; CalculateScoresFromStrengths exercises different code paths
remediation: Add tests for each strategy's CalculateScoresFromStrengths with varied strengths, identical strengths (range < 1e-9), and single entry.

title: Repository UpdateAsync and GetAllAsync methods have zero test coverage
rule_violated: Testing: CRUD operations not covered — UpdateAsync/GetAllAsync are not tested in any repository
remediation: Add tests for all UpdateAsync and GetAllAsync methods across all three repositories. Include edge: update non-existent ID, empty table, update with zero scores.

title: ValidatePartitionedGraph tests fail to assert error message content
rule_violated: Testing: assertions must verify the specific failure reason, not just that failure occurred
remediation: Add Assert.Equal(...) for result.ErrorMessage in both disconnected and cycle test cases to validate correct error discrimination.

title: LessThan operator never tested in IsTotalOrder or IsValidOrder
rule_violated: Testing: enum value coverage — Operator.LessThan is used in production (keyboard handler) but not in any validation test
remediation: Add one test each for IsTotalOrder and IsValidOrder with a LessThan relation to verify directional inversion.

title: E2E tests are shallow smoke tests with no functional workflow validation
rule_violated: Testing: E2E tests should validate critical user workflows, not just page render
remediation: Add E2E test for full judging workflow: create category, add entries, record comparisons, calculate results, verify leaderboard. Add backup/restore test.

title: TrimmingSafetyTests uses fragile string-contains assertions for JSON validation
rule_violated: Testing: string-based assertions on serialized output are fragile and nondeterministic
remediation: Remove the string-contains assertions. The deserialized object check on lines 38-39 already validates correct round-trip.

title: PartitionService constructor validation (k <= 0, invalid overlap) untested
rule_violated: Testing: constructor guard clauses should be verified with theory/parameterized tests
remediation: Add Theory with InlineData for: k=0, k=-1, overlap=-0.1, overlap=1.1 — all should throw ArgumentException.

title: ScoringStrategy empty-tiers and single-entry edge cases untested
evidence_snippet:
// All three scoring files: early return for empty tiers untested
if (k == 0) return assignedScores;           // LinearSpacing, DefinedInterval
if (totalEntries == 0) return assignedScores; // Percentile
if (totalEntries == 1 || sortedTiers.Count == 1) { ... }  // Percentile single entry path
rule_violated: Testing: edge case and boundary condition coverage for algorithmic methods
remediation: Add tests: empty tiers for each strategy, single entry/single tier for PercentileScoring.

title: Entry.SetScore boundary values (0 and maxScore) never tested
rule_violated: Testing: boundary value analysis — valid edge values at the boundary should be tested
remediation: Add Theory with InlineData for SetScore(category, 0) and SetScore(category, category.MaxScore) to validate boundary acceptance.
